[[Alex Purcell]] }} The '''party guests''' are characters {{In|FOTV}}. ==Background== The party guests are people attending the wrap party for a promotional shoot for the [[Vault-Tec Corporation|Vault-Tec]] vaults, at [[Cooper Howard]]'s house. Most of them are [[Vault-Tec employee (TV series)|Vault-Tec employees]], including [[Bud Askins]]. ==''Fallout'' TV series== ===[[The Trap]]=== The party guests are all seen mingling with each other as Cooper walks by them all with a cigarette and a glass of bourbon in hand and later a martini. ==Notable quotes== * {{Inline quote|Negotiations in Anchorage are having a serious impact on presales.|A party guest talking to another party guest}} ==Appearances== The party guests appears only {{in|FOTV}}. {{FOTV appearances|6=106}} ==Behind the scenes== * Apart from three guests with credited speaking roles, most of the unnamed party guests are portrayed by uncredited background actors. * David Denowitz self-credits his character as a "sales leader,"[https://archive.ph/gzeRM David Denowitz on Backstage (archived)] while Zeby Khan self-credits his character as "Ahmad, impressed guest."[https://archive.ph/DDUg3 Zeby Khan's resume (archived)] ==References== {{References}} {{Navbox characters FOTV}} [[Category:Fallout TV series human characters]]
